teaser: The sign-in table at the parent-teacher evening runs out of pens before it runs out of parents, and you are the one producing a second pen, a second chair, a kind word for the mother at the back. That is life path 33 wearing ENFJ letters: a number built around wide, selfless care meeting a type built to notice what a room needs and supply it. Other pairings would hand over the spare chair and sit down. You stay, remembering a child's name from months back. The caring turns into a performance of caring — warm, real, and quietly draining.
